selected_because: Compared b11836, b11838 and b11840; b11836 already implements qwen35/qwen35moe hybrid gated-delta graphs. Ember's whitelist, not missing upstream implementation, caused the reported rejection.

b11838 adds the ggml_time_us overflow fix and behavior-check CI without changing inference APIs, architecture graphs or Android CMake configuration. b11840 adds irrelevant Hexagon CEIL/UI dependency work, so the smaller published patch revision is selected.

CPU-only static llama/ggml build for arm64-v8a and x86_64 remains unchanged. Native model load/context/tokenizer/sampler/memory APIs require host and Android CI validation for this pin; real Qwen3.5 inference is a separate, currently unverified claim.
